# `scene` dialect

CEIR-17 sec-45/46/47 ceir.scene: the SCENE / query / resource RESOLVER semantics. The host scene→drawlist pipeline (REN-37 material/technique stack + the scene_renderer variant ladder + the frame_runtime draw build) resolves, per draw, its material → technique → program → geometry into GPU handles BEFORE scene.raster records. This dialect gives that resolution its declared CEIR IDENTITY: the four scene.resolve_* ops are NATIVE INTRINSICS (ADR-0110 [op.native] provider=host — the replaceable convenience tier: a user MAY write a different resolver as a CEIR program) that the host implements behind the ADR-0106 #3 IFrameGraphHost seam (CEIR-17b extends the crd-ceir-gpu RenderResolvers callback family; crd-ceir core NEVER links gpu-context — I3/I4). ⛔ CURRENCY RULE (the band's spine): the ECS extract stays HOST; CEIR sees OPAQUE handles/ids ONLY, never ECS types — draw / material / technique / program / geometry are 8a Extern TYPE-CLASSES (the attachment precedent: the ROLE rides the TYPE, so resolve_technique's operand is material-typed and the chain is verifier-checkable), each a DISTINCT TypeId. ⛔ NOT Pure: the resolvers read MUTABLE host + scene state (RAF-11 hot-reload can swap the resolved program mid-session; a scene edit changes the material/geometry assignment) — each op carries the NARROWEST HONEST read effect (SceneRead for the scene-assigned material/geometry, HostStateRead for the hot-reloadable technique/program registries) so no CEIR-26 pass may CSE/hoist a resolve across a reload/scene-edit boundary. Determinism is ExternalNondeterminism (deterministic given the current host state, but that state changes externally). Well-formedness rides the module-walk verifier Context::find_scene_misuse (the find_render_misuse house pattern): each resolve op's operands are the RIGHT scene type-class (draw / material / technique), phase is in its closed vocabulary. ⛔ NO-FOLLOW (named, never silently subset): the query → DrawList bridge (the [[draw_list]] semantics) → CEIR-17c; GPU cull + indirect → CEIR-17d; skinned palette-compute orchestration → CEIR-17e; the RenderResolvers host-callback family that IMPLEMENTS these intrinsics → CEIR-17b (this slice is DECLARE-only: types + ops + verifier + tests).

**4 ops:** `resolve_geometry`, `resolve_material`, `resolve_program`, `resolve_technique`

## `scene.resolve_program`

Resolve the raster program for a technique + draw variant (host intrinsic; reads the hot-reloadable program registry + the draw variant).

scene.resolve_program(%technique, %draw) -> %program. A HOST intrinsic: resolves the raster program for the technique + the draw's variant flags through the REN-37 variant ladder (technique->program registry HostStateRead + the draw variant SceneRead; hot-reloadable, so NOT Pure). find_scene_misuse: operand(0) is scene.technique-typed; operand(1) is scene.draw-typed.
